test_title: PYST 17: Selection Post (GraduatiOn Level) - English (Held On 28 June, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.

Why was such a letter written by your brother?

options.text: Why is your brother writing such a letter?
Why has your brother written such a letter?
Why did your brother write such a letter?
Why your brother wrote such a letter?

solution:
The correct answer is** "Why did your brother write such a letter?"**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The original sentence is in passive voice, and the challenge is to convert it into active voice.
 
• The correct active voice maintains the original meaning while correct
